paragraphs: Porter Lee Corporation sells forensic laboratory information management systems (LIMS) and evidence handling software to crime laboratories and law enforcement agencies, and has done so for more than 25 years. Its products were born in the crime lab and police property room and are tailored for those environments. From the beginning the product line has been designed to help collect and preserve forensic evidence, provide an unbreakable chain-of-custody record and improve the day-to-day efficiency of the agencies using it.

The LIMS is in use with more than 50 laboratory customers. Those customers comprise 97 laboratory sites, many of them ANAB/ASCLD/LAB accredited. The evidence tracking package is used by more than 790 state, county and municipal police agencies across America and internationally.

Porter Lee Corporation is ISO registered to the ISO 9001:2015 standard. Additional products listed on the site include a Laboratory Asset Manager, a DNA Analysis Module, a Medical Examiner System, the CODNA DNA Profiles Database and COBIS Ballistics Identification. The site also announces a LIMS User Group 2025 conference for its users.
